lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines. Spacing is significantly wider on the anterior torso (shoulders) and becomes progressively tighter toward the posterior (haunches).
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One prominent Y-shaped bifurcation is located on the 3rd vertical line from the posterior, splitting into two segments approximately 15% down from the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Visible discontinuities and dashed segments on the 6th and 8th lines from the posterior, where lines terminate or fragment in the mid-torso region.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 4-5 high-contrast white spots is located on the lateral surface of the upper hind limb, positioned ventral to the terminus of the first two posterior lines.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two white spots on the lower posterior haunch align horizontally, forming a short geometric axis.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast facial markers including two white spots on the lower cheek, a white horizontal band across the bridge of the muzzle, and white 'sock' markings on the lower portions of all four limbs.
